content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All posts advertised under the recruitment notification are contractual in nature. The salary and remunerations are negotiable for deserving candidates. Pay and allowances shall be decided by the University from time to time based on qualifications, experience, and performance of the employee. Appointments shall be subject to the approval of the competent authority and recognition of the ITEP Programme by NCTE, and governed by the Statutes, Ordinances, Rules, and Regulations of Cotton University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Cotton University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official website at www.cottonuniversity.ac.in . Fill out the application form completely and sign it. Send a copy of the duly filled and signed application via email to [email protected] on or before 26 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM. Prepare the duly filled-in application in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, proof of date of birth, caste certificate (where applicable), and any other relevant testimonials. Submit all physical documents during the time of the walk-in interview. Bring 2 (two) copies of passport-size photographs during the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is Cotton University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Cotton University Recruitment 2026 is a faculty hiring process for 10 temporary and contractual positions for the Four-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) at the Department of Education.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been notified, which include 1 position for Head of the Department, 8 positions for Assistant Professor in Liberal Discipline & Pedagogy and Educational Studies, and 1 part-time position for Assistant Professor in Art Education.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application by email?
faq.answer: The last date to send the scanned copy of the filled and signed application form to [email protected] is 26 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What are the dates for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The tentative dates for the walk-in interview are 31 October 2026 and 2 November 2026, starting at 9:00 AM at the Conference Hall, MCB Building, Cotton University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the HOD post?
faq.answer: Candidates for the Head of the Department post must hold a Post Graduate degree in Education with minimum 55% marks, an M.Ed. degree with minimum 55% marks, Ph.D. in Education or NET/SLET qualification, along with eight years of teaching experience for Professor or ten years for Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Cotton University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What salary is offered for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The salary and remunerations are negotiable for deserving candidates, and pay will be decided by the University based on qualifications, experience, and performance.

faq.question: Q8. Are these positions permanent?
faq.answer: No, all the posts advertised under this recruitment notification are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the prescribed application form from the official Cotton University website at www.cottonuniversity.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, proof of date of birth, caste certificate, original documents for verification, and 2 passport-size photographs.
